# A04-S54: Publication proposal

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

I think I never really answered your email and your offer to produce a synthetic ARK; I talked with the editorial roots and we agree that it could be fun with a new collaboration. Our immediate fascination is probably primarily the strangely doll-like 'photographic' images (Proust etc.) with traces of revolutionary aesthetics and agitprop. So if you can imagine ARK as a bearer of an aesthetic Oprob pamphlet or something in that direction… There is still also missing a government platform, but that is probably not realistic to achieve so quickly!
 Think about it and let's keep in touch.

[…]
